meaning:
ἀφειδία (L, -εία), -ας, ἡ
(ἀφειδής, unsparing);
1. extravagance.
2. unsparing treatment, severity: Col.2:23.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: These things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship, humility, and severity to the body; but aren’t of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.
